responsibility: This header declares the comment-descriptor interface used by the mc lexer and parser passes. It defines the opaque comment handle and exports operations to start a comment block, append text, query or extract its content, classify it as a procedure/body/after-statement comment, and test its kind, forming the public API for comment preservation in the front end.
same_name_distinction: Declares the opaque comment descriptor type and public operations for creating, filling, classifying, and querying preserved comments. Unlike GmcComment.cc, it exposes the interface only and not the descriptor fields or classification implementation.
